raw.details:
The Mandate: Stop Building Throwaway Prototypes. Build a Venture-Ready Company.

Most hackathons end with a static slide deck and an abandoned GitHub repository. Galuxium Nexus V3 is the global arena where raw engineering transforms into live, revenue-generating digital infrastructure. Building on the massive momentum of Galuxium Nexus V2—which united over 1,000 engineers, product architects, and founders worldwide—V3 raises the stakes to unprecedented heights.

Whether you are engineering autonomous AI agents, architecting developer productivity engines, or launching scalable B2B/B2C SaaS platforms, your mandate is absolute: Build production-grade software that real users and enterprises will actually pay for.

Core Innovation Tracks

  • Autonomous AI & Multi-Agent Systems: Self-directed workflows, enterprise copilots, and intelligent orchestration engines capable of complex reasoning and execution.
  • Next-Gen Creator & Media Infrastructure: High-performance tools for video automation, spatial intelligence, generative media, and audience monetization.
  • Enterprise SaaS & FinTech Automation: High-availability platforms solving critical B2B bottlenecks, compliance, billing, and workflow optimization.
  • Developer Velocity & Cloud Infrastructure: DevOps automation, API ecosystems, security frameworks, and deep-work tooling.

Competition Format & Process

  • Round 1: Venture Blueprint & System Architecture (Ideation): Submit a structured breakdown detailing the exact market friction, system architecture, target customer cohort, and monetization framework (SaaS subscriptions, usage-based API billing, or transactional fees).
  • Round 2: The Production Build (Operational MVP): Shortlisted teams engineer and deploy a live, end-to-end working product. Submissions require a public/accessible GitHub repository, a live deployed URL, and a 3-minute technical & commercial walkthrough video.


Rules & Submission Guidelines

  • Original Execution: All core product logic and architecture must be engineered during the official competition window. Boilerplates and open-source libraries are permitted, provided they are declared.
  • Production Benchmark: Static Figma mockups or non-functional wrappers will be disqualified. Prototypes must execute primary user workflows with real state management.
  • Mandatory Synchronization: All team leaders and members must join the official Galuxium Command Center (Discord) and follow the Executive Ledger (LinkedIn) for deployment keys, live mentorship, and compliance updates.

Judging Criteria

  • Commercial Viability & Monetization Architecture: 25%
  • Technical Complexity, Scalability & System Design: 25%
  • Product Polish, UI/UX & Live Execution: 20%
  • Innovation & Market Defensibility: 20%
  • Executive Pitch & Demonstration: 10%
